source_policy: Official vendor codeload archives, exact same-day stable baseline pins. Original skill bytes unchanged. No custom skills, symlinks, foreign-host config, global runtime upgrade or always-on hooks.
guidance_install_method: Downloaded codeload zip URLs in candidates; extracted all regular files into new pinned source roots with traversal guard; used shutil.copyfile for each exact source/destination in engineering-guidance-files.json. No upstream file edited. Curated selected-only parents retain original hierarchy and full required reference subtrees. No npm/bun package install or lifecycle command used for guidance.

scope.backup: New-only paths; no incumbent/shared config changed, hence no backup necessary.
scope.source_review: Relevant original selected entries, actual licenses, package manifests, OMP loader, SpecKit init/entrypoint/network surfaces, ADHD extension activation, Superpowers helper dependencies; metadata inventory and individual decision for remaining subskills. Not an exhaustive line-by-line security audit.
scope.host_activation_note: ADHD extension imports @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent, registers /i-have-adhd and adhd flag, reads agent-level alwaysOn/flag config, and reinjects persistent rules. It was deliberately not copied or registered as executable extension; only original optional skill text is installed. Superpowers package pi.extensions declares .pi/extensions/superpowers.ts; capability discovery registers only selected skills, not this package.

constraints: Append only selected one-level parents; never complete source root or global includeSkills.
No selected raw name appeared in observed incumbent inventory; no same-name overwrite or downgrade.
OMP manualSkills hides metadata without disabling skill:// access; source evidence mcp-builder-omp-v18.18.0-skills.ts lines 611-619.
No package/extension/plugin registration: custom skill directories only.
Superpowers vendor superpowers:name cross-host labels are not OMP slash commands; OMP names are bare entries in receipt, native tool/agent/safety/verification ownership wins.
